characters.name: Gladias
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Veridia thread; a Keeper in the Order of Steering, husband of Seila, father of Zven and Lily. Thoughtful, earnest, a bit naive and philosophical; calm, curious, humble when wrong.

characters.name: Zei
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Dzego thread; national Minpentai champion and gifted cryptographer. Curious, quick, precise; explains technical things fluently and matter-of-factly; friendly host to Gladias. Occasionally speaks Dzegoban.

characters.name: librarian
characters.voice_notes: Robed librarian of the Pafogai Du grand library; wry, playful, a little theatrical, amused and welcoming.

characters.name: library robot
characters.voice_notes: Drinks-service robot in the library; one short Dzegoban phrase. Flat, polite synthetic voice.

notes: No exceptions. 19:37 and 19:43 are Zei speaking Dzegoban voice commands to his watch (softer voice); 19:120 is the robot in Dzegoban. The long letter at 19:175 is N-coded on-screen text but is written in the first person by Deluin (teen male from Redshire, Zei's friend and Minpentai rival, signs it himself) - you may want Deluin's voice or a 'letter' treatment for it; I did not list it under narrator_exceptions because Deluin does not start with N and it is written, not spoken. Likewise 19:133 is a prompt typed by Deluin's program, and 19:154/19:159 contain remembered quotes inside narration. All lettered attributions confident.
